theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_approxTangent_of_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (a : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → (∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap a (lams (φ k)) '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M a Q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
